text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: rollout_id=rollout-2026-03-17-09, wave=1, targets=eu-west-1 (10%)

maria: seeing a jump in 5xx from the canary group - trend started ~30s after wave start. dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/rollouts/rollout-2026-03-17-09

maria: healthcheck fail rate on canary tasks ~12% vs baseline 0.3% :grimacing:
```
canary tasks: task-ef3a, task-ef3b, task-ef3c
probe  /health  200 -> 503 on failing tasks
avg p95 latency: 620ms (baseline 120ms)
5xx rate: 12.4% -> mainly auth proxy upstream 502
```

opsbot: Alert: canary-healthcheck-failure triggered (severity: high) - paging oncall@eng-oncall

maria: paging raj - can you take this? I'm finishing up a customer call. @raj

raj: on it. quick look: errors concentrated on two hosts behind lb-22, seems upstream 502 spike from auth-proxy pool. also seeing KV cache miss surge on those nodes.

elaine: canary abort criteria in deploy config says abort-if >=5% 5xx for 2m. We're past that window. recommend flip kill-switch for feature flag `new-routing-v2` and start rollback. :warning:

maria: +1 flip flag now, please. also notify support for potential customer impact.

raj: flipping flag -> `feature-flag-client set new-routing-v2 off --env=prod --scope=eu-west-1`

support: FYI notifying customers on affected routes. estimated affected requests ~0.8% of total, focused on EU users. Will post status update if we confirm rollback.

deploy-bot: Feature flag change accepted: new-routing-v2=off by raj at 09:12:43 UTC

maria: starting rollback of rollout-2026-03-17-09 -> rolling back wave1 to previous model variant. command: `/deploy rollback rollout-2026-03-17-09 --wave=1 --force`

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for rollout-2026-03-17-09 wave=1 by maria. Estimated completion 2m.

raj: observing metrics after flag flip - healthy tasks returning, 5xx dropping. p95 back to ~140ms within 90s.

opsbot: Incident created INC-2026-1743 - canary-health-abort. Pager cleared for oncall after handoff to raj.

maria: thanks team. handoff to @raj for post-rollback validation and postmortem notes. I'll add the customer call notes to the incident.

raj: will validate end-to-end, capture logs from task-ef3a/b/c and check auth-proxy pool for error spike correlation. tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre for follow-up.

elaine: add a guard in rollout config to require auth-proxy circuit-breaker softening for next waves and annotate the runbook.

support: posting initial status on status.redwood: "Degraded responses for a small subset of EU requests during a canary rollout. Rollback completed, mitigation in place, investigating root cause."

maria: closing short update: rollback completed, customer impact small but real, follow-up postmortem scheduled. :white_check_mark:
